scope.purpose: Exact-name mechanics and provenance refresh while preserving existing PQ relationship identities.

evidence.use: Maintained Xenoverse 2 Super Soul catalogue corroborates character ownership, triggers, effects, magnitudes, durations, Limit Bursts, and PQ endpoints for the selected records.
Maintained all-Parallel-Quest guide independently corroborates PQ131-PQ134 acquisition placement for the selected Super Souls.
DLC catalogue corroborates the Extra Pack 4 placement of the PQ131-PQ134 Super Souls.
Independent community reference corroborates the no-Ki-depletion behavior and Extra Pack 4/PQ132 context for the Vegeta Super Soul.
Independent community reference corroborates Kakunsa's charged-attack trigger, strike/melee boost, movement-speed boost, stacking behavior, and Limit Burst.
Independent community discussion corroborates the Krillin Super Soul's +12 Ki and +12 Stamina contribution; no unsupported Limit Burst value was promoted.

limits: Exact reward/drop probabilities and Ultimate-Finish gating were not inferred from catalogue or community listings.
Canonical PQ relationships remain authoritative; no relationship identity was added, removed, or renamed.
Record 217's +12 Ki/+12 Stamina values are corroborated by community documentation, but its Limit Burst remains unresolved because the retrieved evidence did not establish it cleanly.
The audit records evidence-backed mechanics only; unresolved fields remain null rather than being guessed.
